design: 64 prompts:2 families x8 new items x4 forms. Forms0/1 differ by instruction verb, equal token length and identical answer-introducing suffix; forms2/3 use prior broad-format contrast. All targets single tokens. Freeze before inference; no filtering. Three frozen probes, +/-0.02.
scope: New relative to H633 task panel; some country names appeared in earlier language tasks. Matched templates change one lexical instruction, not every possible construction attribute.
